explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 98 named tracks and releases across current official Bandcamp pages, current Juno techno/minimal/dub and adjacent dance windows, recent label catalogues, overlooked 2025–2026 material and the full 64-track canonical boundary map. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: All required canonical, discussion, revisit, history, map and publication state passed pre-audit; no objective, listener-authorized, revisit or workflow-health REPAIR is actionable.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, PARKED, placement-specific REJECT, preserved exact alternate, unresolved exact identity and repository-wide utility identity was excluded; same-title tracks by different artists were not conflated.
Nine leads come from nine releases; no release supplies more than one lead and no shared release framing is used to select multiple titles.
Planned boundaries avoid those evaluated in the previous five completed discovery runs.
Current-release scanning is balanced with adjacent and overlooked catalogue material rather than treated as a recency quota.
Retailer and official-label prose is attributed rather than measured; identity, duration and all other musical dimensions require resolver or lawful evidence.
Neither listener-protected internal handoff is split; the one post-trio placement follows Stardancer.
